slides.slide_title: Introduce Latin roots: port rupt dict struct vis

content_payload.back_text: Latin roots — carry, break, say, build, see

slides.teacher_cue: Latin roots are the core meaning units that appear in many English words. Five roots today. port = carry: transport, report, import, export, support, portable, porter. rupt = break: disrupt, interrupt, erupt, corrupt, abrupt. dict = say: predict, dictate, verdict, contradict. struct = build: construct, instruct, structure, destruction. vis = see: vision, visible, visit, revise, television. Knowing the root unlocks the meaning of dozens of new words at once.
slides.expected_response: Students identify Latin roots in words and use root meaning to infer word meaning.
slides.correction_move: Show each root with its meaning, then build a word web: port → transport (carry across), import (carry in), export (carry out). Students add new words to each web.
slides.observation_note: Watch for students treating each word as isolated — redirect to the root as the meaning key.

slides.teacher_cue: Say transport — trans (across) + port (carry) = carry across. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say transport orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model transport orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for tr cluster and or vowel in port.

slides.teacher_cue: Say disrupt — dis (away) + rupt (break) = break apart. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say disrupt orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model disrupt orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for dis- prefix and r_l in rupt.

slides.teacher_cue: Say predict — pre (before) + dict (say) = say before. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say predict orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model predict orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for pre- prefix and the dict root.

slides.teacher_cue: Say construct — con (together) + struct (build) = build together. str cluster in struct. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say construct orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model construct orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for con- prefix and str cluster in struct.

slides.teacher_cue: Say visible — vis (see) + ible (able to) = able to be seen. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say visible orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model visible orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /v/ not /b/ in vis- and schwa in -ible.

slides.teacher_cue: Say report — re (back) + port (carry) = carry back. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say report orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model report orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for re- prefix and or vowel in port.
